title: Emotions Wheel
subtitle: From “Bad” to “I’m Overwhelmed but Okay”
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Ever feel “bad” but you can’t explain why?

  • Bad -> Stressed -> Overwhelmed -> Overextended
  • Sad -> Lonely -> Vulnerable -> Abandoned

That’s where the emotions wheel comes in.
It helps you take a vague feeling and zoom in:

Naming the feeling can make it feel less scary,
like shining a flashlight under the couch.
Once you know what it is, you can decide what to do next.

I suggest you pair it with a gratitude list.
